data.narrative:
ARX Robotics is a Series A-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Marc Wietfeld that has raised €42M to date. Valuation is supported by a peer set of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the €42M raised proxy, implying €84M ($84M). Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comparable set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. The peer median reflects valuations of Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B), all at Series B stage.

The two methods produce a wide but defined range. Triangulation across both approaches supports a low-end estimate of $71M, a median of $542M, and a high-end scenario of $1.1B. The substantial spread reflects uncertainty inherent in early-stage defense-tech valuation, including variable revenue maturity and contract backlog visibility across the peer set. Stage discount relative to Series B comparables and capital efficiency metrics would be the primary drivers of positioning within this range.
